name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 82 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2025-08-07, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
